issue.description:
Found by beadrs-65cd875e (sha256-reproduction verification, closed by dispatcher with 'verification is the gate's job'): every commit SHA recorded in pinned-binaries/ is an unreachable object in this repository, so scripts/build-from-archive.sh can never build any recorded pin, and any verification gate that tries will fail at the first command.

EVIDENCE (2026-09-03, repo not shallow, origin/main = 63c2ee8 present locally):
- git archive fails 'fatal: not a tree object' for af023ad47740cf5458f52398e70937b2cc1c18df, 946a7271796e15452c4a8a1f1ff9efc05d3e7307, 1ee45e39f518a1e47a26fd312bbadbc36b1af00c, e1156098b01264bb998797047115521261443c13, f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060 (all from pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md + commits.json), and 6561869ba87fa1391967abf6877e51ef6425301b (BUILD_PROCEDURE.md).
- These SHAs belong to the force-pushed-away lineage (see COMMITS.md's own note on b0d7840 and merge b057d27 'reconcile force-pushed twin lineage'). The twin lineage was restored, but the pins were never re-pointed at the restored SHAs.
- Content twins reachable on main today, same messages, different SHAs: ea4e317 (chore(beadrs-4fcead71): release 0.2.4 ...), c8836e0 (docs(build): add reproducible build instructions ...), 861cdcb (feat(tests): add binary variant integration test suite ...), b0d7840 (docs(attempts-binary): add comprehensive build process ...).
- The committed pin ARTIFACTS are fine: all four binaries in pinned-binaries/ sha256-match their .metadata.json (verified 2026-09-03). The gap is source buildability, not artifact integrity.
- Separately, BUILD_PROCEDURE.md's pair 6561869 -> 0690918612738e0ff4717e9a9d54434a6bc734b67890fe99d767c5de780d02be is doubly orphaned: the commit is unreachable AND the hash matches no committed artifact anywhere in pinned-binaries/.

SCOPE:
- Decide per pin: (a) re-point COMMITS.md/commits.json/metadata files at the restored-lineage twin SHAs, explicitly noting the sha256 was recorded on the lost lineage and is verify-by-hash-only, or (b) recover the original objects (another clone, origin side, reflog on the machine that built them) if byte-true rebuilds matter — they cannot matter until build.rs determinism lands (beadrs-dc295092 / beadrs-baba38b8), since builds embed wall-clock time.
- BUILD_PROCEDURE.md: drop or annotate the 6561869 -> 0690... pair; it corresponds to no commit and no artifact. Coordinate with the doc-rewrite beads (beadrs-ef0e6cf9, beadrs-0998a466, beadrs-8352f5b8) rather than editing twice.
- Acceptance: every SHA named in pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md and BUILD_PROCEDURE.md resolves via git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit} in a fresh clone of origin, and each pin states whether its recorded sha256 is rebuild-verifiable or hash-only.
issue.notes: FLAG from beadrs-d6e639c7 (pin-inventory audit, 2026-09-03T00:32Z): while re-pointing metadata files, note bead-pre-attempt-resolution.metadata.json records binary_size_bytes 7340032 (exactly 7 MiB) but the on-disk binary is 7305144 bytes; its recorded sha256 d0da42bb…9ac6 DOES match disk, so only the size field drifted. README claims only '7.0M' and is unaffected.
issue.title: Pinned-binary SHAs in COMMITS.md/BUILD_PROCEDURE.md are unreachable objects; re-pin against the restored lineage

issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) decides on a third dependency kind `verifies` so authors can declare a check relationship, and diagnoses inverted verification gates structurally from that declaration instead of title heuristics. It is explicitly 'specified as post-0.1 item R025', the project is past 0.2.x, and no open bead covers it. Work: extend the §3.4 two-kind set with `verifies` (schema field guide entry, validation, dep-add CLI surface, checkpoint round-trip with unknown-field discipline); detect a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead; report the inversion as an advisory diagnosis (doctor, dependencies scope) — never reject the edge at insert time, never infer the relationship from titles. Add round-trip, concurrency, and negative tests, plus conformance that the diagnosis is silent when no `verifies` edges are declared.

issue.description:
ADR-005 records as an open drawback that there is 'currently no way to mark an assignment as intentionally held', so a workspace that legitimately parks work under an assignee triggers the doctor assignment-held warning on every run — the documented path to warning fatigue and the warning losing its meaning. Add an explicit operator-set marker (e.g., a held/parked flag or structured annotation via `bead update`) that excludes an open+assigned issue from the ready_frontier warning; surface the marker in list/show and in the warning's sample output so deliberate holds are distinguishable from residue; cover it with doctor tests (marked issues silent, unmarked still warned, marker survives checkpoint round trips) and keep the marker advisory-only so claim eligibility is unchanged. Coordinate with beadrs-892eb8ce (`manual_blocked` surfacing) so the two states are not conflated.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Allow marking an assignment as intentionally held so the ready-frontier warning can exclude it
